description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for verifying the behavior of 'git status' with various options related to rename detection and renaming behaviors. It sets up test scenarios involving renamed files, ignores, and different renaming thresholds, and checks the output to ensure git behaves as expected under these configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines individual test cases expecting success, executing provided commands and verifying conditions.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for specific patterns in the test output files to verify expected behavior.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
